effect.name: Lose Not, Forget Not

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by {energy_regeneration_rate} and increases Outgoing Healing when they use their Ultimate by {use_their_ultimate}.
effect.name: Mutual Healing

effect.description: At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates {energy} Energy for a randomly chosen ally (excluding the wearer) whose current Energy is lower than 50%.
effect.name: Enjoy With Rapture

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates a fixed amount of 20 Energy. This effect can trigger 1 time each wave. After the wearer uses Skill to attack, inflicts the target with the "Purgatory" state, lasting for 2 turn(s). While in the "Purgatory" state, the target receives {max_hp} increased CRIT DMG and {max_hp} additionally increased CRIT DMG from the wearer.
effect.name: Tempering

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate}. When the wearer deals DMG to an enemy inflicted with Wind Shear, Burn, Shock, or Bleed, each respectively grants 1 stack of Prophet, stacking up to 4 time(s). In a single battle, only 1 stack of Prophet can be granted for each type of DoT. Every stack of Prophet increases wearer's ATK by {atk} and enables the DoT dealt to ignore {enables_the_dot} of the target's DEF.
effect.name: Crystallize

effect.description: When memosprite's turn starts, the wearer and memosprite each gain 1 stack of "Commemoration." Each stack increases DMG dealt by {stack_increases_dmg}, stacking up to 4 time(s). When memosprite disappears, removes "Commemoration" from the wearer and memosprite.
effect.name: Going to Sleep

data.name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

effect.description: When the wearer hits an enemy and if the hit enemy is not already "Ensnared," then there is a {ensnared_then_there} base chance to "Ensnare" the hit enemy. "Ensnared" enemies' DEF decreases by {enemies_def_decreases} for 1 turn(s).
effect.name: Glance Back

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. After a CRIT Hit, there is a {crit_hit_there} fixed chance to dispel 1 buff on the target enemy. This effect can only trigger 1 time per attack.
effect.name: Raging Waves

effect.description: |effect_path    = Remembrance
effect.name: |effect         =

effect.description: After entering battle, increases the wearer's SPD by {spd} and DMG by {spd_and_dmg}. When the wearer takes DMG, this effect will disappear. This effect will resume after the end of the wearer's next turn.
effect.name: Stave Off the Lingering Cold

effect.description: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases ATK by {ultimate_increases_atk} for 2 turn(s).
effect.name: Genius

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. The Break DMG dealt by the wearer ignores {break_dmg} of the target's DEF. When the wearer's Break Effect in battle is at 150% or greater, increases their SPD by {spd}.
effect.name: Rough Water

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. After the wearer uses Ultimate to attack enemy targets, inflicts the targets with the "Woefree" state, lasting for 2 turn(s). While in "Woefree," enemy targets take {while_in_woefree} increased DMG. The effect of increasing DMG taken is additionally boosted by {increasing_dmg} if the wearer's current Break Effect is 150% or higher.
effect.name: Contentment

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. The Skill DMG and Follow-up ATK DMG dealt by the wearer increase by {crit_dmg}.
effect.name: Persistence

effect.description: When the wearer summons memosprite for the first time, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) and regenerates {energy} Energy for this unit.
effect.name: Beautify

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. When entering battle or after dealing Break DMG, increases SPD by {dmg_increases_spd}, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can only trigger once per turn.
effect.name: Concealment

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. When using Skill, regenerates {energy} Energy for all allies.
effect.name: Cure and Repair

effect.description: The wearer deals {more_dmg} more DMG to enemy targets whose HP percentage is greater than 50%.
effect.name: Eradication

effect.description:
Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp} and Energy Regeneration Rate by {energy_regeneration_rate}. When the wearer's HP is reduced, all allies' DMG dealt increases by {all_allies_dmg}, lasting for 2 turn(s).
At the start of every wave, restores HP to all allies by an amount equal to {wave_restores_hp} of their respective lost HP.
effect.name: Visioscape

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. When the wearer's Basic ATK or Skill DMG does not result in a CRIT Hit, increases their CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}, lasting for 1 turn(s). This effect can only trigger once every 3 turn(s).
effect.name: Sweet Dreams

effect.description: When Aha Instant is activated, the wearer's Elation increases by {elation}, lasting until Aha Instant ends.
effect.name: Indulgence

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases DoT dealt by the wearer by {ultimate_increases_dot}, lasting for 2 turn(s). When a target enemy suffering from DoT imposed by the wearer is defeated, regenerates {energy} Energy for the wearer.
effect.name: Chaos Elixir

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer defeats an enemy or is hit, immediately restores HP equal to {immediately_restores_hp} of the wearer's ATK. At the same time, the wearer's DMG is increased by {atk} until the end of their next turn. This effect cannot stack and can only trigger 1 time per turn.
effect.name: Kinship

effect.description: The wearer's Basic ATK and Skill deals {more_dmg} more DMG. This effect increases by an extra {more_dmg} when the wearer's current Energy reaches its max level.
effect.name: Like Before You Leave!

effect.description: |effect_path    = Elation
effect.name: |effect         =

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases the DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite by {dmg}.
effect.name: Come Train!

effect.description: For each time the wearer hits the same target, DMG dealt increases by {same_target_dmg}, stacking up to 5 time(s). This effect will be dispelled when the wearer changes targets.
effect.name: Answers of Their Own

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by {effect_res}. If the wearer is attacked and has no Shield, they gain a Shield equal to {shield} of their Max HP for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every 3 turn(s). If the wearer has a Shield when attacked, the DMG they receive decreases by {attacked_the_dmg}.
effect.name: Treasure

effect.description: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by {follow_up_atks}. If the current HP percentage of the enemy target is below or equal to 50%, increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by an extra {follow_up_atks}.
effect.name: The Maiden in the Painting

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer uses an attack and at least 2 attacked enemies have the corresponding Weakness, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by {crit_dmg}, lasting for 2 turn(s).
effect.name: Stratagem

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. At the start of battle or for every 4 instance(s) of Follow-Up ATK the wearer uses, the wearer gains "Umbra Devourer," lasting for 3 turn(s). While the wearer holds "Umbra Devourer," increases ATK by {devourer_increases_atk} and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by {dmg}. Effects of the same type cannot stack.
effect.name: Subsume

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. The CRIT DMG dealt by the wearer's Memosprite increases by {crit_dmg}.
effect.name: Interdependence

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. After the wearer uses Skill, increases ATK by {skill_increases_atk}, stacking up to 3 times.
effect.name: So Good!

effect.description: Increase the wearer's ATK by {atk}. For every 1 different Weakness Type an enemy target has, increase the DMG dealt to it by the wearer by {dmg}. Up to a max of 7 Weakness Types can be taken into account for this effect.
effect.name: Mutual Benefit

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When entering combat, if the allies' Skill Points limit is 6 or higher, increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. After each use of the wearer's Skill, increases the wearer's ATK by {3}, stacking up to 4 time(s).
effect.name: Hrunting

effect.description: When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack enemies, the wearer gains one stack of Mischievous. Each stack increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}.
effect.name: Fantastic Adventure

effect.description: Increases the wearer's DMG by {dmg}. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by {atk}, stacking up to 3 time(s).
effect.name: Get Ready

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. After the wearer's memosprite attacks, the Outgoing Healing of the wearer and their memosprite increases by {outgoing_healing}, lasting for 1 turn(s).
effect.name: Written Down

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT rate by {crit_rate} and increases their Max HP by {crit_rate}. When the wearer is attacked or consumes their own HP, their DMG increases by {hp_their_dmg}. This effect is removed after the wearer uses an attack.
effect.name: Unfulfilled Yearning

effect.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by {def}. Increases the DMG of the wearer when they use their Ultimate by {use_their_ultimate} of the wearer's DEF. This effect only applies 1 time per enemy target during each use of the wearer's Ultimate.
effect.name: New Chapter

effect.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}. When the wearer's memosprite uses a Memosprite Skill on an ally, gains "Blank," which increases DMG taken by all enemies by  {which_increases_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite uses a Memosprite Skill on an enemy, gains "Verse," which increases CRIT DMG of all allies by  {crit_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite has both "Blank" and "Verse," increases the effects of "Blank" and "Verse" by  {blank_and_verse}.
effect.name: A Promise

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate}. After the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack an enemy target, there is a 60% base chance to inflict "Unarmored" on the target. While in the Unarmored state, the enemy target receives {in_the_unarmored} increased DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s). If the target is under a DoT state inflicted by the wearer, there is a 60% base chance to upgrade the "Unarmored" state inflicted by the wearer to the "Cornered" state, which additionally increases the DMG the enemy target receives by {dmg}, lasting for 2 turn(s). During this period, the wearer cannot inflict "Unarmored" on the target.
effect.name: Wordly Affairs Leave No Mark

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer uses Ultimate, restores HP equal to {ultimate_restores_hp} of the wearer's ATK for all allies, and additionally restores HP equal to {ultimate_restores_hp} of the wearer's ATK for the character with the lowest current HP, and grants "Redoubt" to all allies for 3 turn(s). Targets with "Redoubt" deal {dmg} increased DMG, which further increases by {if} if the targets have summons.
effect.name: New Scale

effect.description: The wearer's base SPD increases by {base_spd}. When dealing DMG, ignores {dealing_dmg_ignores} of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by {dmg}.
effect.name: Dispossession

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp} and Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. When the wearer heals allies, record the amount of Outgoing Healing. When any ally launches an attack, a random attacked enemy takes Additional DMG equal to {takes_additional_dmg} of the recorded Outgoing Healing value. The type of this Additional DMG is of the same Type as the wearer's. This Additional DMG is not affected by other buffs, and can only occur 1 time per turn.
effect.name: Morn, Noon, Dusk, and Night

effect.description: Increases the wearer's base SPD by {base_spd}. After the wearer and the wearer's memosprite attacks, the wearer gains 1 stack of "Brocade." Each stack of "Brocade" increases the wearer's and their memosprite's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}, stacking up to 6 time(s). When reaching maximum stacks, each "Brocade" stack additionally increases Basic ATK DMG dealt by {crit_dmg}.
effect.name: Establishment

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability, the wearer gains "Noctis." While the wearer has "Noctis," all allies' memosprites ignore {wearer_has_noctis} of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. Increases the DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite by {max_hp}. When the wearer's memosprite disappears, the wearer recovers {energy} Energy. Similar effects cannot stack.
effect.name: Sleepless

effect.description: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by {energy_increases_dmg}. A max of 160 Energy will be taken into account for this.
effect.name: A Storm Is Coming

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by {crit_rate}, stacking up to 2 times.
effect.name: Decision

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the Elation of all allies by {elation}, lasting for 1 turn(s).
effect.name: Companion

effect.description: Increases the wearer's DEF by {def}. When the wearer is attacked, there is a {def_when} base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to {wearer_deals_dot} of the wearer's DEF for 2 turn(s).
effect.name: A New Round of Shuffling

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by {turn_s} for 3 turn(s).
effect.name: Rye Under the Sun

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg} and Energy Regeneration Rate by {energy_regeneration_rate}. When the wearer's Max Energy is greater than 120, for every 10 points of Max Energy that exceeds this amount, further increases Energy Regeneration Rate by 0.3%. Up to a maximum of 360 points of excess Max Energy can be taken into account. When the wearer uses Elation Skill, increases the DMG received by all enemies by {dmg} for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.
effect.name: Daydream

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by {outgoing_healing}. When an ally target's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to 50%, increases the DMG dealt by {dmg}.
effect.name: Farewell

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by {crit_dmg}. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability on an ally target, increases the DMG dealt by all ally targets by {dmg}, lasting for 3 turn(s).
effect.name: Final Hit

effect.description: At the start of the battle, the wearer's Effect Hit Rate increases by {turn_s} for 3 turn(s).
effect.name: Fallen

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by {max_hp}. When using Basic ATK or Skill, restores all allies' HP by an amount equal to {all_allies_hp} of their respective Max HP.
effect.name: Tiny Light

effect.description: At the start of the battle, the DMG dealt to all allies decreases by {battle_the_dmg} for 5 turn(s). At the same time, immediately restores HP to all allies equal to {immediately_restores_hp} of the respective HP difference between the characters' Max HP and current HP.
effect.name: Teary-Eyed

effect.description: After the wearer uses Basic ATK or Skill, deals Additional DMG equal to {dmg} of the wearer's ATK to a random enemy that has been attacked.
effect.name: A Discourse in Arms

effect.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}, and the Elation DMG dealt ignores {dmg_dealt_ignores} of the target's DEF. When the wearer uses Ultimate on themselves, gains {punchline} "Punchline." This effect can be triggered up to 1 time, and will be reset after using Basic ATK 3 times.
effect.name: Guaranteed Victory

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. After using Basic ATK, restores HP for the wearer by an amount equal to {atk_restores_hp} of Max HP plus 800.
effect.name: Hypothesis

effect.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by {spd}. When the wearer enters combat or uses Ultimate on an ally target, the wearer gains "Great Fortune" for 3 turn(s). While the wearer has "Great Fortune," all allies' CRIT Rate increases by {allies_crit_rate}, CRIT DMG increases by {rate_crit_dmg}, and the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by {energy_regeneration_rate}. At the start of each wave, the wearer regenerates a fixed amount of 15 Energy.
effect.name: Game Changer

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by {break_effect}. When the wearer deals Break DMG to an enemy target, inflicts Routed on the enemy, lasting for 2 turn(s). Targets afflicted with Routed receive {routed_receive} increased Break DMG from the wearer, and their SPD is lowered by 20%. Effects of the same type cannot be stacked.
effect.name: Metamorphosis

effect.description: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by {effect_hit_rate}. When an enemy target gets inflicted with a debuff by the wearer, there is a 80% base chance for them to enter "Enthrallment," lasting for 3 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack. While the target is in "Enthrallment," for every 1 debuff applied by the wearer on the target, increases the target's received DoT by {received_dot}, stacking up to 6 time(s). When the target gets attacked by an ally, increases the attacker's SPD by {spd} for 3 turn(s). When the wearer gets knocked down, removes all "Enthrallment."
effect.name: Solo

effect.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by {atk}, and increases their DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn or Bleed by {burn_or_bleed}. This also applies to DoT.
effect.name: Run!

effect.description: Increase the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate} and increases DMG dealt by follow-up attack by {dmg}. After the wearer uses a follow-up attack, inflicts the target with the Tame state, stacking up to 2 time(s). When allies hit enemy targets under the Tame state, each Tame stack increases the CRIT DMG dealt by {crit_dmg}.
effect.name: One At A Time

effect.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by {crit_rate}. While the wearer is in battle, for every 20% CRIT DMG that exceeds 120%, the DMG dealt by follow-up attack increases by {dmg}. This effect can stack up to 4 time(s). When the battle starts or after the wearer uses their Basic ATK, enables the DMG dealt by Ultimate or follow-up attack to ignore {ultimate} of the target's DEF, lasting for 2 turn(s).
effect.name: Promise
